Definition: Whether procedural rules for collection, storage, and sharing of ID-related personal data are publicly available and established
Comments: Law 03/2016 restricts cross-border data transfers, requiring ANPDP authorisation or notification depending on whether the recipient jurisdiction provides adequate protection. The Leginon platform provides controlled institutional access to SIGA data via secure VPN. However, comprehensive data sharing rules for the forthcoming digital ID system are not yet published; the World Bank project targets a data strategy and action plan as an end-project deliverable. Scored 2 (Partially available).

Definition: Whether national data protection legislation exists and covers personal data linked to the ID system
Comments: Law No. 03/2016 (Personal Data Guarantee and Protection Law), enacted May 10, 2016, establishes a comprehensive data protection framework closely mirroring the EU Data Protection Directive (95/46/EC). It establishes the National Data Protection Agency (ANPDP), defines principles of lawfulness, transparency, proportionality and minimisation, and sets penalties for violations. Scored 2 (Yes).

Definition: Whether a Data Protection Authority or similar body regulates ID data collection and sharing by the ID system
Comments: The National Data Protection Agency (ANPDP - Agência Nacional de Protecção de Dados Pessoais) was established under Law 03/2016. It is operationally active, independently structured, empowered to investigate, subpoena evidence, impose fines, and publish annual reports. The Data Protection Africa fact sheet confirms the ANPDP is 'operational and relatively active in providing authorisations, resolutions, and opinions.' Scored 2 (Yes).
